text: Computer vision is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One key idea is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another important idea is object detection, which means finding and locating objects in an image. Computer vision has many applications in everyday life. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to help them see the road, recognize traffic signs, and avoid accidents. It is also used in security cameras and medical images. Thanks to computer vision, machines can now "see" and understand the world around them.
